react_native_issues.issue: MINOR: outlookLabel() always returns English (BULLISH/BEARISH/NEUTRAL) regardless of language. The hi.json keys verdict.buy/sell/hold ('तेजी'/'मंदी'/'तटस्थ') exist but are NOT used by VerdictBadge or TimeframesCard — they use outlookLabel() directly. Verdict labels are always shown in English even in Hindi mode. Likely intentional for brand consistency but worth flagging.
